name: envelope/hello-request-invalid-version-multibyte
description: implementation_version of 128 emoji is 128 characters but 512 UTF-8 bytes; the §11.8 identifier shape (visible ASCII, at most 128 bytes) rejects it — the old character-count bound admitted the overflow (R0 KENV-05)

expected.reason: implementation_version must be the visible-ASCII/128-byte identifier shape
